Clarify command case sensitivity in User Guide
commitResults.messageBody:
Users may confuse case-sensitive command words with parameter
values that accept different capitalization.

State that command words must be lowercase and distinguish them
from parameter values whose descriptions explicitly ignore case.

Fixes #209

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a help hint for unknown commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Unknown-command errors give users no guidance on finding the
supported commands.

Point users to the User Guide link available through help. Document
the message and cover capitalized commands with a regression test.
Command parsing remains unchanged.

Fixes #211

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify supported tag characters in User Guide
commitResults.messageBody:
The tag rule refers to letters and numbers without explaining that
non-ASCII characters are rejected.

Specify the accepted letter and digit ranges so the guide matches
existing tag validation. Application behaviour remains unchanged.

Fixes #213

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify errors for mixed empty tag edits
commitResults.messageBody:
An empty tag prefix combined with other tag prefixes produces a
generic alphanumeric error that does not explain how to correct it.

Explain that an empty tag prefix must be used alone to clear tags.
Document the restriction and verify rejected edits preserve client
data and history. Existing valid tag edits remain unchanged.

Fixes #215
Clarify command case sensitivity in User Guide

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge master and retain command guidance
commitResults.messageBody:
Master adds lowercase-command guidance at the same location as the
unknown-command help hint.

Retain both explanations in the User Guide to resolve the conflict
without changing application behaviour.
